title: Error Grouping and Log Clustering

engineFeatures.meaning: in currency units, thousands of times larger than the others

label: For "Error Grouping and Log Clustering": Group production errors and log lines into issues by cause so engineers see a few ranked problems instead of millions of events. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Exact message grouping.
